prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Screen Visibility Diagnostic New Screen: Adds a desktop visibility diagnostic sub-screen before completing waiting to verify the pet asset can draw on the user's monitor. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to open, and home waiting step takes a median of 201s.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Trait Tuner Quiz Sub-Flow: Inserts a 3-question pet personality quiz screen into the adoption flow before picking or generating a friend. (why: Adoption step has a low 60.9% conversion and long mean time (1017s), while users complain custom pet generation results look wrong.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Visual Cards Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into side-by-side spotlight choice cards comparing pre-made adoption vs custom creation. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s and dropoff of 23.8%, indicating users struggle to evaluate their choices.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Path Sign-In Step Reorder: Moves the sign_in step directly after pick_friend so users establish their path before signing in. (why: 2 support emails report sign-in stalls, and sign_in mean time is 567s when presented before pet selection.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Screen Troubleshooting Quick-Link: Adds an alternative connection tip and fallback sign-in button on the sign_in screen. (why: Support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to open for some desktop setups.)
5: [finish, hint] Quick Start Companion Hotkey Banner: Adds a high-visibility hotkey summary banner and sound button on the final home_intro screen. (why: Users struggle to control or hide pets after onboarding, leading to support requests.)

scores.note: Targeted home step has moderate dropoff; adding a diagnostic screen addresses desktop rendering issues but adds a step.
Adoption has high dropoff (39.1%); adding a quiz sub-flow addresses generation complaints but adds flow friction.
Choose_path loses 23.8% of users with high mean time; card redesign clarifies options early in the funnel.
Reordering sign_in after pet selection leverages higher user intent and addresses long sign-in durations.
Low cost fix for sign-in stalling issues backed directly by support emails and long mean duration.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users; quick start banner and sound hint directly resolve post-onboarding support complaints at low cost.
